servinfo.title: Precautions for Blind Spot Monitor System

attention1.ptxt: Blind spot monitor system detects a vehicle diagonally in the rear not reflected in the door mirror and tells the driver of the presence. However, the system does not eliminate the driver’s direct observation through the door mirror. Without enough care for direct observation, critical accident may occur.
Checking the circumstances, pay enough attention for safety driving.

item.ptxt: The following vehicles and objects are not a subject of the blind spot monitor system. (Depending on the conditions, things with asterisk (*) could be detected)
Pedestrian, bicycle, small motorcycle, etc. (*)
Oncoming vehicle
Stationary objects such as guard rail, wall, traffic sign, parking vehicle, etc. (*)
A vehicle running behind on the same lane (*)
A vehicle running on two lanes away (*)
Blind spot monitor system may not work under the following conditions.
Positioning and/or aiming of blind spot monitor control module is deviated caused by strong impact to the module or vicinity of the module.
Millimeter wave radar and/or vicinity of the radar on rear bumper is covered with dirt, snow, ice, sticker, etc.
Rear bumper is installed incorrectly.
Rear bumper is damaged, deformed, dented or cracked.
When running through puddles or under bad weather such as heavy rain, snow or dense fog.
Two or more vehicles are approaching one after another continuously.
A vehicle behind is too close.
Speed difference between the vehicle and a vehicle behind in the detecting area is too big.
Speed difference between the vehicle and other vehicle varies.
Vehicle speed between the vehicle and other vehicle in the detecting area is almost the same.
When starting from standstill, another vehicle in the detecting area remains.
The vehicle is running on a continuous winding road with steep uphill or steep downhill, or potholes.
The vehicle is running on a continuous winding road with ups and downs.
The other vehicle running on the neighboring lane is too far due to wide lane, running on edge of lane, etc.
The vehicle is equipped with accessory such as bicycle carrier in the rear.
Height difference between the vehicle and other vehicle in the detecting area is too big.
Right after turning ON blind spot monitor system.
Blind spot monitor system may work unexpectedly under the following cases.
Positioning and/or aiming of blind spot monitor control module is deviated caused by strong impact to the module or vicinity of the module.
Guard rail and/or wall is getting close in the detecting area.
The vehicle is running on a continuous winding road with steep uphill or steep downhill, or potholes.
The other vehicle running on other than the neighboring lane, edge of lane, narrow traffic lane, etc. is getting in the detecting area.
The vehicle is running on a continuous winding road with ups and downs.
Tire is slipping.
A vehicle behind is too close.
The vehicle is equipped with accessory such as bicycle carrier in the rear.
